about.title: About Us
about.content: PixNetMX is a firm focused on customized digital solutions, with emphasis on web development, mobile apps, user experience and system integration. We help companies, entrepreneurs and brands build their digital image, streamline their processes and effectively connect with their audience. We stand out for delivering everything from affordable and functional landings to robust applications, always adapting to each requirement and budget.

mission.title: Mission
mission.content: To empower companies and entrepreneurs with cutting-edge, affordable and scalable technological tools that strengthen their digital presence, add value and enhance the user experience.

vision.title: Vision
vision.content: To position ourselves as leaders in the digital field of Mexico and Latin America, valued for our excellence, creativity and competitive pricing, supporting the technological modernization of businesses of any scale.

values.title: Values
values.innovation: Innovation: We constantly explore alternatives to improve the digital environment.
values.commitment: Commitment: We achieve the goals of those who trust us with responsibility and dedication.
values.quality: Quality: We deliver stable, secure and high-performance projects.

values.collaboration: Collaboration: We work alongside our clients to achieve customized solutions.
values.transparency: Transparency: We openly explain each phase of the work and the associated costs.

distinguish.title: What Sets Us Apart
distinguish.content: At PixNetMX we bring together a group of professionals dedicated to custom system development and design. With industry experience, we generate digital products that exceed our clients' expectations. We are guided by open communication, teamwork and the delivery of impeccable results. We trust that properly conceived software can streamline operations, provide tangible benefits and uncover new business opportunities. We accompany you from the original idea to implementation and ongoing support.

objective.content: To provide businesses of any size with creative, flexible and high-performance software solutions that boost their expansion and advantage in the digital environment.

section1.title: 1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE
section1.content: These terms govern the contracting and provision of software design, development and implementation services through pixnetmx.com. Services include requirements analysis, architecture design, application development, testing, implementation and initial technical support.

section2.title: 2. PARTIES' OBLIGATIONS
providerItems: Develop software according to agreed specifications
Deliver the project within established deadlines
Provide technical documentation and user manuals
Provide technical support during the period established in the contract
clientItems: Provide complete and accurate information for development
Make payments according to the agreed schedule
Designate technical personnel for project coordination
Provide access to systems when necessary for integration
Perform testing and validation within established timeframes

section3.title: 3. DEADLINES AND DELIVERABLES
section3.content: Development timelines will be determined based on the complexity of each project and will be communicated to the client in advance. Deliverables may include, as applicable, source code, executables, technical documentation and user manuals. Any modification to the originally agreed scope may generate adjustments in delivery times and costs.

section4.title: 4. ECONOMIC CONDITIONS AND PAYMENT METHOD
section4.pricesContent: Prices are expressed in Mexican pesos (MXN) and are subject to current VAT.
section4.paymentContent: Payment may be made through the enabled platform, using credit card, debit card or other electronic methods indicated on the site at the time of purchase.

section5.intro: All intellectual property rights related to developments, services and content generated through this site will be governed by the following provisions:
items: Exclusive developments: Once the corresponding total payment has been made and confirmed, developments and code created specifically for the client will become their property.

Third-party tools: Tools, frameworks, libraries and other general-use components employed in development will at all times maintain the original licenses of their respective owners, without implying transfer of additional rights to the client.
Use restrictions: The client may not reproduce, sublicense, commercialize or distribute proprietary components without prior written authorization from their respective owners.
Company rights: The company will retain all rights over its methodologies, processes, technical knowledge and know-how used or developed during the provision of services.

section6.title: 6. WARRANTY AND SUPPORT
warrantyItems: A 90-day warranty is granted against programming defects after final delivery
The warranty covers only documented and reproducible programming errors
It does not cover requirement modifications or problems derived from changes in the client's technological environment
supportItems: Support includes correction of documented errors and basic technical advice
Response time: 24-48 hours on business days
Support via email and scheduled phone calls

section7.title: 7. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
items: Liability is limited to the total amount paid for the service
No liability is assumed for indirect damages, lost profits or information losses not directly attributable to defects in the developed software

items: Both parties agree to maintain confidentiality regarding technical, commercial and strategic information

Confidential information may not be disclosed for a period of 5 years after project completion
Appropriate security measures will be established to protect information

section9.title: 9. CHANGES AND MODIFICATIONS
items: Any modification must be agreed in writing
Changes in project scope may imply adjustments in time and cost
A new quote will be provided for significant modifications

section10.title: 10. DELIVERY AND ACCEPTANCE
items: Delivery is considered complete when the software meets the agreed specifications

refund.intro1: At PIXNETMX we value the trust our clients place in us and we work to offer services of the highest quality. We know that unforeseen situations may arise, which is why we have established this Refund and Cancellation Policy with the objective of providing clarity, transparency and security in every process.
refund.intro2: Here you will find the conditions under which cancellations, refunds and retentions proceed, as well as the rights and responsibilities of both the client and PIXNETMX. Our commitment is to address each request fairly and promptly, always respecting applicable legislation and fostering a long-term relationship of trust.

section1.title: 1. Cancellation by the client
section1.content: The client may request cancellation of services at any time. In such cases:
items: Refunds will be subject to analysis of the actual project progress and costs already incurred.
Work actually performed and partial deliverables may be invoiced or retained until any outstanding balance is settled.
Once the corresponding payments are released, the client will be entitled to receive the progress and documentation generated to date.

section2.title: 2. Cancellation by PIXNETMX
section2.content: PIXNETMX may cancel the service in the event of:
items: Payment default by the client.
Serious breach of contractual obligations assumed by the client.
Improper use of the platform or harm to third-party rights.
section2.footer: In these cases, deliverables will be retained until full settlement and no refunds will proceed for services already rendered.

section3.title: 3. Cancellation due to force majeure
section3.content: In the event of extraordinary events (natural disasters, health emergencies, massive infrastructure failures, acts of authority or other causes beyond the parties' control), PIXNETMX may temporarily suspend services without liability. If the impossibility of execution persists, either party may request definitive termination, resolving payments and deliverables proportionally to progress.

section4.title: 4. Non-refundable services
section4.content: The following will not be subject to refund:
items: Third-party software licenses already acquired.
Domain, hosting or technology infrastructure services already consumed.
Consulting, analysis or advisory services previously rendered.
Third-party expenses previously authorized by the client.

section5.title: 5. Procedure for requesting a refund
section5.content: All requests must be submitted in writing to equipo@pixnetmx.com and include:
items: Client or company name.
Project or service contracted.
Reason for cancellation.
Supporting documentation, if applicable.
section5.footer: PIXNETMX will evaluate each request individually and will communicate the resolution to the client in writing within a maximum of 10 business days, detailing the authorized amount and the refund method.

section6.title: 6. Refund methods and timelines
section6.content: In case of approval, refunds may be made through:
items: Reversal to the original payment method (credit/debit card or bank transfer). Crediting times depend exclusively on the banking institution or card issuer, and may vary between one and several billing cycles.

section7.title: 7. Intellectual property and deliverables
section7.content: PIXNETMX will retain all rights over its own methodologies, processes and know-how. The client will acquire ownership of developments made specifically for their project once the corresponding total payment has been settled.

section8.title: 8. Policy modifications
section8.content: PIXNETMX reserves the right to modify this policy at any time. Updates will be permanently available on the website.

section9.title: 9. Legislation and jurisdiction
section9.content: This policy is governed by the applicable legislation in the United Mexican States. For any controversy, the parties submit to the competent courts of Mexico City, expressly waiving any other jurisdiction that may correspond to them.
